display.purpose: The leading ready lesson in the yellow band.

headline.purpose: Balanced humanist lesson title, at most 25ch.

title.purpose: Learn section headings, not a universal modular scale.

reading.purpose: Lesson prose at a maximum 68ch; 18px/32.4px to 20px/36px at the current root size. The legacy serif token resolves to this same sans-serif family.

label.purpose: Compact, wrapping topic, depth, and reading-time information.

mono.purpose: Reader code blocks with horizontal overflow, not compressed prose.

shadows.name: account-popover
shadows.purpose: Structural account overlay only; ordinary content stays flat.

motion.name: reading-cta
motion.purpose: The inverted reading CTA changes to opacity 0.86 on hover.

motion.name: recovery-control
motion.purpose: Learn and collection recovery control hover.

motion.name: shared-card
motion.purpose: Tonal and border feedback without lifting the card.

motion.name: reader-controls
motion.purpose: Reader buttons and related links/arrows do not animate.

motion.name: topic-edge
motion.value: stroke 120ms ease, stroke-width 120ms ease, opacity 120ms ease
motion.purpose: Flat SVG relationship feedback; stroke-width affects paint, not layout.

motion.name: topic-node-circle
motion.purpose: Flat SVG node feedback, disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; } }
motion.purpose: Global accessibility override, including pseudo-elements and graph paint transitions.

components.name: Reading CTA
components.description: Inverted action in the yellow direction band; 52px minimum height, square edges, accent-ink focus, and full width on phones.
components.css: .ds-direction { --focus-ring: var(--accent-ink); padding: clamp(1.5rem, 4.5vw, 3.5rem); background: var(--accent-surface); color: var(--accent-ink); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 16px; } .ds-read-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1.5rem; min-height: 52px; min-width: 15rem; padding: 0.8rem 1.15rem; background: var(--accent-ink); color: var(--accent-surface); text-decoration: none; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; white-space: nowrap; transition: opacity 120ms ease; } .ds-read-link:hover { opacity: 0.86; } .ds-read-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent-ink); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 600px) { .ds-read-link { width: 100%; min-width: 0; } } @media (max-width: 380px) { .ds-direction { padding: 1.3rem; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-read-link { transition: none; } }

components.name: Reader primary action
components.description: Lesson completion action; yellow fill is retained on hover. Disabled and saved results must follow real current-context state.
components.css: .ds-reader-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.65rem; min-height: 48px; min-width: 10rem; max-width: 100%; padding: 0.65rem 1.125rem; border: 1px solid var(--accent-surface); border-radius: 0.5rem; color: var(--accent-ink); background: var(--accent-surface); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: none; } .ds-reader-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--accent-ink); } .ds-reader-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-reader-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.65; } @media (max-width: 480px) { .ds-reader-primary { width: 100%; } }

components.name: Reader secondary action
components.description: Quiet save control. Apply the saved class and aria-pressed only for the actual saved state.
components.css: .ds-reader-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.65rem; min-height: 44px; min-width: 6.5rem; max-width: 100%; padding: 0.65rem 1.125rem; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 0.5rem; color: var(--fg); background: var(--bg-card); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: none; } .ds-reader-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--fg-muted); background: var(--bg-card-hover); } .ds-reader-secondary.ds-saved, .ds-reader-secondary.ds-saved:hover:not(:disabled) { color: var(--accent-ink); border-color: var(--accent-surface); background: var(--accent-surface); } .ds-reader-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-reader-secondary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.65; }

components.name: Learn recovery action
components.description: Flat outlined recovery or supporting action, with a 44px minimum target.
components.css: .ds-learn-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.6rem 0.95rem; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; color: var(--fg); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4; text-align: center; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease; } .ds-learn-button:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--bg-card-hover); } .ds-learn-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-learn-button:disabled { color: var(--fg-muted); cursor: not-allowed; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-learn-button { transition: none; } }

components.name: Reader question field
components.description: Labeled, vertically resizable reader textarea with adjacent unboxed error feedback. Preview text is illustrative, not lesson data or a live result.
components.html: Unable to send the question. Try again.
components.css: .ds-reader-form { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 0.625rem; align-items: start; margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-reader-form label { color: var(--fg); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-reader-form textarea { width: 100%; min-width: 0; min-height: 6rem; padding: 0.875rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 0.5rem; color: var(--fg); background: var(--bg-card); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.6; resize: vertical; } .ds-reader-form textarea::placeholder { color: var(--fg-subtle); opacity: 1; } .ds-reader-form textarea:focus, .ds-reader-form textarea:focus-visible { border-color: var(--focus-ring); outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-reader-error { margin: 0.75rem 0; padding: 0; border: 0; color: var(--error); background: none; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.65; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

components.name: Primary navigation
components.description: Learn, Topics, Saved, and History remain visible. The shell places navigation on its own row at 1000px; phones use four equal columns.
components.html: LearnTopicsSavedHistory
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 1.4rem; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.95rem; } .ds-nav a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; color: var(--fg-muted); text-decoration: none; padding: 0.5rem 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; white-space: nowrap; flex-shrink: 0; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-nav a.ds-active { font-weight: 700; } .ds-nav a.ds-active, .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--fg); border-bottom-color: var(--accent); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 1000px) { .ds-nav { gap: 1.8rem; } } @media (max-width: 600px) { .ds-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-nav a { padding: 0.4rem 0.1rem; } }

components.name: Topic chip
components.description: Pill-shaped topic filter; foreground and accent border indicate selection without claiming mastery.
components.css: .ds-topic-chip { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--bg-card); color: var(--fg-muted); border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.33rem 0.62rem; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.8rem; line-height: 1.6; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-topic-chip.ds-active, .ds-topic-chip:hover { color: var(--fg); border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-topic-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Reader callout
components.description: Neutral reader panel, including warning and remember variants; only those titles take accent foreground. No lift or warning-tinted reader background.
components.html:
Remember

Keep the explanation connected to its lesson context.
components.css: .ds-callout { display: block; margin: 1.5em 0; padding: 1rem 1.125rem; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 0.5rem; color: var(--fg); background: var(--bg-card); font-family: var(--font-reading, var(--font-sans)); font-size: clamp(1.125rem, 1.05rem + 0.3vw, 1.25rem); line-height: 1.8; font-style: normal; } .ds-callout-title { margin: 0 0 0.35rem; color: var(--fg); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: normal; text-transform: none; } .ds-callout-warn .ds-callout-title, .ds-callout-remember .ds-callout-title { color: var(--accent); } .ds-callout p { margin: 0.35rem 0 0; }

components.name: Reader disclosure
components.description: Native details/summary for optional provenance, questions, and feedback; preserves a marker, focus, and phone-stacked hint.
components.html:
Sources Lesson context
Source context and citations appear here when available.
components.css: .ds-disclosure { margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--fg); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-disclosure > summary { min-height: 56px; padding: 1rem 0; color: var(--fg); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.6; cursor: pointer; list-style-position: outside; margin-left: 1.125rem; } .ds-disclosure > summary::marker { color: var(--fg-subtle); font-size: 0.8em; } .ds-disclosure > summary:hover { color: var(--link); } .ds-disclosure > summary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-disclosure-hint { display: inline-block; margin-left: 0.75rem; color: var(--fg-muted); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; } .ds-disclosure-content { padding: 0.25rem 0 1.5rem; } @media (max-width: 480px) { .ds-disclosure-hint { display: block; margin-left: 0; } }

components.name: Collection recovery notice
components.description: Strongly bordered neutral recovery notice, not an empty collection or success state. Error wording in this preview is illustrative.
components.html:
Unable to load lessons.

Try again to reload the collection.
components.css: .ds-collection-error { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; margin: 1rem 0; padding: 1rem 1.2rem; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); background: var(--bg-card); color: var(--fg); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-collection-error p { margin: 0; } .ds-collection-error .ds-error-detail { margin-top: 0.4rem; color: var(--error); font-size: 0.9rem; } .ds-collection-error button { min-height: 44px; padding: 0.6rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; color: var(--fg); font: inherit; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease; } .ds-collection-error button:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--bg-card-hover); } .ds-collection-error button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-collection-error button:disabled { color: var(--fg-muted); cursor: not-allowed; } @media (max-width: 500px) { .ds-collection-error { align-items: flex-start; flex-direction: column; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-collection-error button { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Atlas is focused personal learning: a clear next reading choice, strong humanist headings, and supporting information that stays quiet. Cool neutral surfaces and a yellow direction band carry the approved balanced composition; the lesson itself remains comfortable and unhurried.

Controls are flat and functional. Borders, spacing, and typography establish hierarchy rather than decorative depth. Both themes belong to the same world. The approved anti-references are a newsroom composition and the separate 3D experiments, not useful topic relationships or real work context.
keyCharacteristics: Humanist headings and a quiet, generous reader.
Flat controls, ruled retrieval lists, and explicit states.
Consistent light and dark themes with phone-first reading.

rules.name: The Role Pairing Rule
rules.body: Keep accent ink on accent surfaces, body text on neutral surfaces, and semantic text paired with its own state surface; switch complete theme roles rather than isolated colors.

rules.name: The Quiet Reader Rule
rules.body: Keep readable body type and its measure intact; separate metadata, questions, feedback, and provenance from the main lesson rather than making them compete with it.

dos: Do preserve the approved yellow direction band, cool neutral palette, humanist type, and quiet reader in both themes.
Do keep Learn, Topics, Saved, and History visible and use real lesson, relevance, and source-context data.
Do preserve the reader's 68ch maximum measure, fluid reading size, and 1.8 line-height.
Do retain explicit pending, empty, error, disabled, and saved states, keyboard focus, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do describe intro/intermediate/deep as reading coverage and topic relationships as suggestions.
donts: Don't introduce a serif reading world, decorative 3D, or a newsroom composition.
Don't copy example lesson content from the approved composition into production or invent mastery scores.
Don't present queued lessons as ready, browser-local review state as assessed mastery, or lesson publication as verified software deployment.
Don't turn optional reader disclosures into competing primary panels or apply the popover shadow to ordinary content.
Don't invent palette ramps, replacement tokens, or success feedback to conceal missing data or failed operations.
